_note: Made up for this course, except forecastPlace, which is real (see its _source). The events and rain limits are invented for practice. They are not safety rules: the organiser always decides. Every event is open to everyone.

forecastPlace._source: Open-Meteo Geocoding API (https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search), which uses GeoNames data under CC BY 4.0. Checked 11 Nov 2026. Coordinates rounded to four decimal places.
